name: a cancelled board takes its tree and overlay writes with it, silently: each ends coalesced by cancel
a cancelled tag takes the link keyed by it and the mark on it with it, silently
a cancel removes only the dependent part of an entry: its independent deltas stay ready
a dependent of a held create is held back unsent, so the cancel folds it too
a create and a delete of the same record, both unsent, cancel
a held delete released onto its ready create cancels both
an update and a delete of an existing record join and keep the delete
a delete, a revive and a delete of a confirmed record join without cancelling: alive without the joined entry, the record keeps its final delete
a held delete, a revive and a delete, then Undo of the held delete: the final delete stands
a revive and a delete of a spent record join to one delete: only a create cancels
a revive that writes a label, a delete and a revive of a spent record keep the label: the joined entry is never cancelled
